children: Elmet Group, through Elmet Technologies, signed an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire OSRAM’s tungsten and molybdenum metal production operations in Schwabmünchen, Germany. The price will be set at closing from a formula that includes a fixed -€18 million base, pension adjustments, a €1 million restructuring prepayment, and a €3.875 million working-capital peg. Elmet will assume certain employee, pension, and contract liabilities, while OSRAM retains the real estate. Subject to closing, OSRAM will also extend an interest-free €2.5 million vendor loan, repayable in two equal installments at six and twelve months after the Effective Date.
